title: Tax Zones
description: Configure tax rates by country and region.

help.title: About Tax Zones
help.overview: Tax zones decide the tax charged at checkout and the VAT share inside till prices. A zone covers one country, optionally narrowed to states and postal codes, and holds one or more named rates.

sections.title: Matching an address
sections.body: Checkout uses the shipping address; the till uses its first warehouse's address.
items: Country must match. Listed states narrow it; empty states cover the whole country.
Postal patterns are optional; * is the only wildcard, for example 10*.
Every active zone that matches applies, highest priority first. An address that matches no zone pays no tax.

sections.title: Rates
items: Each rate has a name, a percentage, and what it applies to: all products, physical only, or digital only.
Physical, variable, and bundle products take physical rates; digital products take digital rates; every product takes all rates.
A compound rate is charged on the base plus the taxes already added before it.

sections.title: How the amount is calculated
items: Lines are grouped by physical, digital, and other, the order discount is shared across the groups by value, and each group is taxed with its rates.
The order keeps a breakdown per rate name and percentage.
Till prices include VAT: the tax share is extracted from the price rather than added on top.
Activate and deactivate switch the zone on and off. Deleting is a soft delete and it can be restored.
